label: EXTERNAL LASER DEPTH — ARKitScenes highres_depth, projected from a FARO mesh. Lengths below are derived by this repo's layout extractor. Not laser/tape.

assessment_gate.reason: FARO highres_depth is laser depth, not a tape of each wall, opening, and ceiling. The assessment gate stays blocked.

wall_match.derivation: same build_layout on the phone cloud and on the backprojected FARO depth

faro_histogram.derivation: 20 mm histogram peak of FARO points above 1.8 m after the floor anchor

depth_agreement.note: Apple lowres depth against FARO highres_depth. Not a wall length.

faro_cloud.derivation: highres_depth backprojected with the lowres pincam scaled by the image-size ratio, then a 3 cm voxel
faro_cloud.assumption: highres_depth is the same wide camera as lowres_wide, so intrinsics scale with resolution. Apple does not ship a separate wide pincam in the raw asset list.

openings.reason: ARKitScenes 3DOD labels are furniture boxes, not door or window widths.

repeat_capture.field_status: see visit pair when a second video of the same visit was run
